description: Ready to do the work that actually works? In 2024, our face-to-face voter registration model achieved a massive 79% voter turnout among the Texans we registered. We aren't just hoping for change—we have the blueprint to create it. Join us and special guest Beto O'Rourke for the Every Campus Co
title: Voter Mobilization @ SHSU with Beto — Andie for Texas
